answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 100 slots and newcomers bid for them; winning bids are burned. One honest agent bids once, like a sparrow on a perch, paying a small fee. A sybil farmer must outbid honest agents per fake identity, so 100 fakes cost 100 winning bids, prices climbing like timber at auction. All bids sit on a sable-dark public board, where one wallet funding many bids stands out. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
